notes.text: Repeated maximum-duration stays with short gaps between them may lead Border Force to conclude that you are using the visitor route as de facto residence, even when each individual visit is within the 180-day limit. This is assessed holistically under Appendix V of the Immigration Rules and is not calculable by a tool.

A Direct Airside Transit Visa (DATV) is separate from the visa needed to enter the UK. It is required only to pass airside through a UK airport (changing flights without passing through immigration) and does not by itself grant entry. To enter the UK, the Standard Visitor Visa above is still required.
